```yaml
name: C# Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
    paths:
      - 'csharp/**'
      - '.github/workflows/csharp-tests.yml'
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/csharp-tests.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: '10.0.x'
        
    - name: Build solution
      run: |
        dotnet build "GSDK_CSharp_Standard.sln" -c Release
        
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        dotnet test "csharp/Tests/Tests.csproj" -c Release --no-build
```
